description: List the spending categories that appear in the user's transactions, with transaction count and net dollar total per category, largest first. Default window is the last 90 days. These are the values the category parameter of list_transactions accepts. The response includes a `warnings` array of notices about banks that could not contribute (for example, a bank that needs reconnecting), each with a message and, when relevant, a reconnect_url.

end_date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today.

start_date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to 90 days ago.

name: list_categories
title: List Spending Categories
